episodes.instruction: Grab the dark mug with a curved handle, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the medium-sized rack.
Pick the cylindrical mug with handle from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the mug with rounded bottom and handle from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the mug with rounded bottom and handle on the medium-sized rack.
